title: Radiation-activatable pressure-sensitive adhesive tape with dark reaction and use thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a pressure-sensitive adhesive tape comprising or consisting of a radiation-activatable polymerizable composition comprising or consisting of: A) 5 to 60 parts by weight of at least one film former component; B) 40 to 95 parts by weight of at least one epoxide component; C) 0.1 to 10 parts by weight of at least one photoinitiator; and D) any Optionally 0.1 to 200 parts by weight of at least one additive, in each case relative to the radiation-activatable polymerizable composition, wherein the parts by weight of components A and B add up to 100, characterised as a film former Component A comprises or consists of at least one polyurethane polymer. The invention also relates to a method of connecting two components by means of such an adhesive tape and to the use of such an adhesive tape.
